Short title and commencement

ACT XVIII OF 1994
THE STAMP (SINDH-AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XVIII OF 1994
An Act to amend the Stamp Act, 1899, in its application to the Province
of Sindh.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 28th July, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-9/94, dated
28-7-1994.--The Stamp(Sindh Amendment) Bill, 1994 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 15th June, 1994 and assented to by the Governor
of Sindh on 20th July, 1994 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of
Sindh:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Stamp (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force on
and from 2nd May, 1994.

Amendment of Schedule I of Act No.II of 1899

ACT XVIII OF 1994
THE STAMP (SINDH-AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XVIII OF 1994
An Act to amend the Stamp Act, 1899, in its application to the Province
of Sindh.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 28th July, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-9/94, dated
28-7-1994.--The Stamp(Sindh Amendment) Bill, 1994 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 15th June, 1994 and assented to by the Governor
of Sindh on 20th July, 1994 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of
Sindh:--
2. Amendment of Schedule I of Act No.II of 1899--In the Stamp Act.
1899, in its application to the Province of Sindh Schedule I, in Article 5,
under the heading "Exemptions" clause (a) shall be deleted.

Repeal

repealed.
